storagePolicies.qual:
((bucket_id = 'billing-documents'::text) AND (has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) OR can_access_organization(
CASE
    WHEN (((storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'organizations'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[2] ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text)) THEN ((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid
    WHEN ((storage.foldername(name))[1] ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) THEN ((storage.foldername(name))[1])::uuid
    ELSE NULL::uuid
END, 'documents.read'::text)))

storagePolicies.qual: ((bucket_id <> ALL (ARRAY['program-files'::text, 'program-documents'::text])) OR ((bucket_id = 'program-files'::text) AND (split_part(name, '/'::text, 1) = 'programs'::text) AND (split_part(name, '/'::text, 3) <> ''::text) AND uc_document_action_allowed(storage_try_uuid(split_part(name, '/'::text, 2)), 'read'::text, NULL::uuid, NULL::uuid)))

storagePolicies.with_check: ((bucket_id <> 'external-contracts'::text) OR (((owner = auth.uid()) OR (owner_id = (auth.uid())::text)) AND ((owner IS NULL) OR (owner = auth.uid())) AND ((NULLIF(owner_id, ''::text) IS NULL) OR (owner_id = (auth.uid())::text)) AND (uc_signature_canonical_file(storage_try_uuid(split_part(name, '/'::text, 1)), storage_try_uuid(split_part(name, '/'::text, 3)), name) OR (split_part(name, '/'::text, 2) = 'signed-scans'::text))))
